scripts.build: npm exec -- node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm exec -- node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const walk=(root)=>{for(const entry of fs.readdirSync(root,{withFileTypes:true})){const candidate=path.join(root,entry.name);if(entry.isDirectory()){walk(candidate);} else if(candidate.endsWith('.js')||candidate.endsWith('.d.ts')||candidate.endsWith('.map')){const target=path.join('dist',path.basename(candidate));if(candidate!==target){fs.copyFileSync(candidate,target);}}}};if (fs.existsSync('dist/commandrelay-client/src')){walk('dist/commandrelay-client/src');}const candidates=['dist/index.js','dist/commandrelay-client/src/index.js'];const typeCandidates=['dist/index.d.ts','dist/commandrelay-client/src/index.d.ts'];const srcCandidates=['dist/index.js.map','dist/commandrelay-client/src/index.js.map'];let target='';let typeTarget='';let sourceTarget='';for(const candidate of candidates){if(fs.existsSync(candidate)){target=candidate;break;}}for(const candidate of typeCandidates){if(fs.existsSync(candidate)){typeTarget=candidate;break;}}for(const candidate of srcCandidates){if(fs.existsSync(candidate)){sourceTarget=candidate;break;}}if(!target || !typeTarget){throw new Error('dist artifacts for @commandrelay/client not found in expected paths');}if(target!=='dist/index.js'){fs.copyFileSync(target,'dist/index.js');}if(typeTarget!=='dist/index.d.ts'){fs.copyFileSync(typeTarget,'dist/index.d.ts');}if(sourceTarget && sourceTarget!=='dist/index.js.map'){fs.copyFileSync(sourceTarget,'dist/index.js.map');}"
